name: JavDB v3
deviceFindingsFromTest5: Hand-authored select:// JSON for search-history management returned an invalid JSEngine value on-device.
The Articles entry was visible but the page did not reliably expose actual JavDB article data.
The Filter page still felt visually inconsistent around the Tag dimension and label/value semantics.
More Playback placed JavDB official playback and third-party providers in the same visual row.

changes.searchHistory: Replaces handcrafted select:// JSON with the documented $(options,1,title).select(...) interaction. Single-record deletion and clear-all both mutate local history then refresh the Search page.
changes.filters: Left-side green chips are now treated as stable dimension labels for Resource/Year/Month/Duration/Tag. The Tag group row and the active Tag-value row are separated: Tag is the green label, groups are neutral choices, then the selected group becomes the green label for its full value row. Resource/Year/Month/Duration also expose an explicit All choice.
changes.articles: Adds direct public signed GET /api/v1/articles list rendering and GET /api/v1/articles/:id detail rendering. Article title/cover/author/category/date/content/images/source link and related movies are preserved when returned.
changes.playback: More Playback is split into three blocks: JavDB Playback, Third-party Playback, and JavDB Official Magnets. Official VIP/preview can no longer share a row with MissAV/123AV/Jable.
changes.dataCompleteness: Keeps the Test5 restored entry points for news, series, makers, directors, TOP250, playback rankings, actor rankings, account want/watched/favorites/lists/recent, and resource tools.
